fact: The party follows Droki's trail east into the Fungi Forest.
source_quote: At an intersection, the party follows Droki's crumbs east.
subject: following Droki's trail

fact: Thorin moves to the back of the group because his armor is too loud.
source_quote: "I'm like clink clank every time I step."
subject: Thorin

fact: The Fungi Forest is a dense area filled with giant mushrooms, some standing nearly five feet tall.
source_quote: a dense forest of giant mushrooms, some standing nearly five feet tall
subject: Fungi Forest

fact: The Fungi Forest produces an eerie whispering sound resembling wind breathing through the fungi.
source_quote: a hissing sound starts to rise, like uncounted tiny voices whispering in tongues you don't understand
subject: Fungi Forest

fact: Pelek reassures the group that the whispering sounds from the fungi are harmless.
source_quote: Pelek reassured the group that the noise was harmless, just the wind of the Underdark breathing through the fungi
subject: Pelek

fact: Thorin considers covering their mouths against possible spores in the fungi forest.
source_quote: Thorin considers covering mouths against possible spores.
subject: Thorin considers covering mouths

fact: The terrain in the Fungi Forest is difficult.
source_quote: The forest is difficult terrain.
subject: Fungi Forest

fact: Gyrgum climbs a tall mushroom to spot a tunnel heading southwest.
source_quote: Gyrgum climbs a tall mushroom and spots a tunnel heading southwest.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The party begins foraging for Underdark mushrooms, including barrelstalks and bluecaps.
source_quote: They begin foraging for various Underdark mushrooms, including barrelstalks and bluecaps.
subject: foraging for mushrooms

fact: Nilhogg's Nose is a type of mushroom found in the Fungi Forest.
source_quote: The DM also mentions Nilhogg's Nose.
subject: Nilhogg's Nose

fact: Thorin tracks mushroom quantities in a separate inventory column.
source_quote: Thorin tracks them in a separate inventory column.
subject: Thorin

fact: Two swarms of centipedes ambush the party from the surrounding mushrooms.
source_quote: While the party harvests the fungi, two swarms of centipedes ambush them from the surrounding mushrooms.
subject: centipede ambush

fact: Pelek hovers near Gyrgum to keep his bones safe.
source_quote: Pelek hovers wherever Gyrgum is to keep his bones safe.
subject: Pelek

fact: Centipede swarms cannot be grappled or restrained.
source_quote: Swarms can't be grappled or restrained.
subject: centipede swarm

fact: Daz asks if Maximilian's Earthen Grasp works on swarms and is told it does not.
source_quote: Daz asks about Maximilian's Earthen Grasp and is told no.
subject: Maximilian's Earthen Grasp question

fact: Centipede swarms can move through other creatures' spaces.
source_quote: Swarms can move through other creatures' spaces.
subject: centipede swarm

fact: A single-target spell hits the centipede swarm, but area spells also hit allies covered by the swarm.
source_quote: Single-target spells hit only the swarm, but area spells will also hit an ally the swarm covers.
subject: centipede swarm

fact: Zalthir punches a centipede swarm twice, dealing 6 damage on the second hit.
source_quote: he punches at the swarm and hits twice, the second for 6 damage.
subject: Zalthir punches swarm

fact: Daz casts Toll the Dead on the centipede swarms, but the swarm makes its Wisdom save and resists.
source_quote: Daz casts Toll the Dead against the creatures, but the swarm makes its Wisdom save and resists the effect.
subject: Daz casts Toll the Dead

fact: A centipede swarm crawls onto Zalthir, covering him in biting insects.
source_quote: A swarm crawls onto Zalthir, covering him in biting insects.
subject: centipede swarm

fact: The centipede swarm's bite misses Zalthir because the insects stumble on his clothes and scales.
source_quote: Its bite misses his AC 16 as the centipedes "stumble on your clothes, your scales, on each other."
subject: centipede swarm

fact: Gyrgum unleashes a stream of caustic acid at the swarms, but they dodge with a 19 on the Dexterity save.
source_quote: Gyrgum unleashes a stream of caustic acid at the swarms, but the insects roll a 19 on the Dexterity save and dodge the brunt of the spray.
subject: Gyrgum sprays acid

fact: Thorin strikes a centipede swarm for 10 damage, leaving it at 1 hit point.
source_quote: Thorin strikes a swarm for 10 damage, leaving it at 1 hit point
subject: Thorin strikes swarm

fact: Thorin uses Action Surge after striking a swarm.
source_quote: then uses Action Surge.
subject: Thorin uses Action Surge

fact: The players discover they can draw spell-effect animations on the map.
source_quote: The players also discover they can draw spell-effect animations on the map ("It was in the wrong place, but it looked really cool").
subject: map animations

fact: A centipede swarm covers Gyrgum and bites, but misses his AC 14 with a roll of 13.
source_quote: A second swarm moves to cover Gyrgum and bites, but its roll of 13 falls just short of his AC 14
subject: centipede swarm

fact: Two additional centipede swarms emerge from the fungi, one initially hidden under Pelek's token.
source_quote: Two additional swarms emerge from the surrounding fungi, one of them initially hidden under Pelek's token, further surrounding the party.
subject: additional swarms emerge

fact: Daz passes a nature check establishing that the centipede swarms are not infinite.
source_quote: A nature check establishes, through Daz, that the swarms are not infinite.
subject: nature check

fact: Pelek starts to tell a ghost story about adventurers but stops mid-sentence.
source_quote: Pelek starts to tell a ghost story about a group of adventurers, then stops mid-sentence.
subject: Pelek

fact: Zalthir finishes off the centipede swarm covering him.
source_quote: Zalthir finishes off the swarm covering him
subject: Zalthir finishes swarm

fact: Zalthir moves at half speed through difficult terrain to punch another cluster for 10 damage.
source_quote: then moves at half speed through the difficult terrain to engage another cluster, punching for 10 damage.
subject: Zalthir moves and punches

fact: Daz uses Toll the Dead on a wounded centipede swarm for 6 damage.
source_quote: Daz uses Toll the Dead on a wounded swarm for 6 damage.
subject: Daz casts Toll the Dead

fact: Gyrgum hits with his hand axe for 4 damage but misses with his mace.
source_quote: His hand axe hits (15) for 4 damage and his mace swing misses entirely (7).
subject: Gyrgum two-weapon fighting

fact: The DM notes that a five-foot space is large, resembling hitting all the bugs.
source_quote: The DM notes that a five-foot space is big, "so it's more like you hitting all these bugs."
subject: battle space

fact: Thorin attempts a tactical strike with a superiority die but fails to land the blow.
source_quote: Thorin attempts a tactical strike, adding a superiority die to a missed attack, but still fails to land the blow.
subject: Thorin tactical strike

fact: The session ends mid-combat with the party still surrounded by centipede swarms.
source_quote: The session ends mid-combat with the party still surrounded by centipede swarms.
subject: session ends

fact: The centipede swarms are alive and surrounding the party as the session ends.
source_quote: the mushroom forest alive with the sound of countless skittering legs
subject: centipede swarm
